goal: Complete a fast and impactful Kokoro Link activation without slowing battle input.
acceptance_criteria: Each activation presents only the selected reserve monster.
Cut-in, attribute-colored light, compact impact, aura, and the Kokoro Link title share one 600ms sequence.
No 300ms alternate sequence exists and battle busy state is not changed by the animation.
Reduced-motion users receive a calm title treatment.
Save data, IDs, effect values, target binding, and switch behavior remain unchanged.

phases.deliverable: Fixed the one-source, 600ms, non-blocking presentation and compatibility boundary.

phases.name: implementation
phases.deliverable: Added the activation layers, persistent aura, reduced-motion treatment, notice, cache keys, and dedicated test.

phases.name: integration_qa_and_safe_merge
phases.deliverable: Dedicated and full checks passed; PR #146 CI succeeded from current main without conflict and was squash-merged.
